Operational Trigger Conditions: Read-only queries, single unambiguous entity match, quota safe
Autonomous Action Protocol: Autonomous tool dispatch; immediate responder synthesis.

Operational Trigger Conditions: Multi-candidate match (e.g. 2 active badminton bookings), partial slot mention
Autonomous Action Protocol: Halt execution; prompt user with enumerated candidate selection menu.

Operational Trigger Conditions: State-modifying actions (create booking, cancellation, user block/unblock)
Autonomous Action Protocol: Arm pending confirmation in session memory; require explicit user affirmation.
